main.description: Create a Lead record. Raw email/phone/full name are NOT accepted here — callers must hash email/phone client-side and stash the raw PII in the tenant's Tier 3 Preferences (com.etzhayyim.apps.opensaas.salesforce.contactPrivate) using the returned leadDid as the key.

leadUri.description: AT URI of the created lead record
